answer_4.quote: We randomly select 500 samples from the Sem16, P-Stance, Covid19, and VAST datasets and use human evaluation (with three evaluators who are not involved in this work) to measure the quality of the data generated by ChatGPT.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators answered yes/no questions on whether the filtered episodic knowledge is relevant to the sample, whether filtered redundant content does not contain required knowledge, and whether generated discourse knowledge is consistent with the original content.
